notes: Minimap Compass now keeps itself up to date: it checks this manifest on every DungeonHelper start, downloads any newer build and swaps it in on shutdown, so the next launch is current. The settings panel shows where the check got to. The swap now retries until DungeonHelper has released the file instead of giving up after four seconds and discarding the download, and an update staged by a session that was closed abruptly is still applied the next time DH shuts down cleanly.
